name: Filipino Pork Adobo sa Gata (Pork Adobo in Coconut Milk)
ingredients_verbatim: 3 pounds pork shoulder Kasim or belly (Liempo), cut into 2-inch cubes
why: Verified published nutrition sits squarely mid-band (510 cal, 11 g carbs, 35 g protein per serving) - high protein for the calories and structurally low-carb (pork + coconut milk + soy/vinegar braise, no rice/bean/potato base in the dish itself). Braised/shredded pork shoulder, scales cleanly to 14 in one pot. Distinct from the catalog's existing plain slow-cooker-filipino-pork-adobo-bowls: the coconut-milk (sa gata) sauce is a different Bicol/Southern-style dish, not a trivial variation. Main ingredients map to the Omaha board; bay leaves and fresh Thai chili have no board home (flagged per this run's pricer-lane exercise).
